title: ForageBites
description: FOR ANY INQUIRIES DM WONGERS432 ON DISCORD ForageBites is a client side Fabric mod for Hypixel Skyblock that tracks your foraging efficiency by displaying real time Trees Per Minute TPM and session averages via a customizable drag and drop HUD overlay
body:
🌲 Features
ForageBites is a client-side Fabric mod designed specifically to help track your foraging rates in Hypixel Skyblock. By listening for the "Tree Gift." chat messages, it provides precise, real-time statistics about your foraging efficiency directly on your screen.

📊 Real-Time Tracking
Rolling-Minute TPM (Trees Per Minute): A sliding-window tracker that precisely calculates and displays how many trees you have cut in the last 60 seconds.
Session-Based Tracking: Want to track a long foraging session? Use the built-in session tracker to calculate your average TPM over an extended period. You can start, pause, unpause, and stop sessions on the fly!
Session Summaries: When you stop a session, you'll get a neat summary printed in chat showing your final average TPM, total tree gifts collected, and total elapsed session time.

🖥️ Customizable HUD
Live Statistics: See your live per-minute TPM and your session average TPM seamlessly on your screen.
Tree Gift Notifications: An optional on-screen "Tree Gift!" text pop-up appears for 2 seconds whenever a tree gift is registered, keeping you motivated.
Click-and-Drag GUI Editor: Don't like where the text is placed? Use /fb gui to open an intuitive, interactive screen where you can click and drag any of the HUD elements (TPM widget, Session widget, or Notify widget) anywhere on your screen!

⚙️ Full Control & Persistence
Commands Galore: Control every aspect of the mod with the base /fb command:
/fb help - Shows a helpful list of all commands.
/fb gui - Opens the HUD editor.
/fb tpm - Toggles the per-minute HUD overlay on/off.
/fb chatnotify - Toggles the "Tree Gift!" text notification on/off.
/fb session start | pause | unpause | stop - Fully control your session tracking.
Persistent Configuration: All of your preferences, including your toggles and custom HUD positions, are saved automatically to a config file (foragebites.json). They will persist perfectly across game restarts!
